sections_en.text: V-A AC voltage measuring instrument, model YOKOGAWA
Voltage injection test set, model PHU-100
Work Steps to be Carried Out

rows: Insert Test plug type RTXH into Test socket type RTXP 18 on the relay (a59G).
Connect the Start leads of the time measuring instrument to points (T1, T2) on the PHU-100 voltage injection test set.
Connect the Stop leads of the time measuring instrument to points (17, 18) on Test plug type RTXH 18.
Inject voltage onto points (9, 10) on Test plug type RTXH 18.
Raise the voltage gradually until the first stage indication appears.
Record the first stage voltage value.
Switch off the voltage injection test set.
Connect the voltage injection test set.
Record the first stage time value.
Raise the voltage gradually until the second stage indication appears.
Record the second stage voltage value.
Switch off the voltage injection test set.
Connect the voltage injection test set.
Record the second stage time value.
Switch off the voltage injection test set.
Withdraw Test plug type RTXH 18 from Test socket type RTXP 18 on the relay (a59G).

text_en:
Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Maintenance Procedures Information System
 | Protection Devices | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: OVR-002-r0a | Equipment: Testing the generator overvoltage protection x59G RXEG21 ABB
Issued to: Assiut Power Generation Station
Status: Approved
Approval date: 07 September 2003 | Procedure: Using secondary circuit injection
Next review date: September 2003
Introduction
This document sets out the test steps for the protection device mentioned above. The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at Assiut Power Station, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company. The field test was carried out on 19 October 2002 by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed.
Safety Precautions
The unit is out of service.
Open the work order.
Fence off the work area and place warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.
The unit is out of service.
Open the work order.
Fence off the work area and place warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.
Tools, Instruments and Equipment Used
Test plug, model RTXH 18
V-A AC voltage measuring instrument, model YOKOGAWA
Voltage injection test set, model PHU-100
Millisecond Counter (Timer ) Type MCS - 5N
Test leads
Test plug, model RTXH 18
Work Steps to be Carried Out
Insert Test plug type RTXH into Test socket type RTXP 18 on the relay (a59G). | 1
Connect the Start leads of the time measuring instrument to points (T1, T2) on the PHU-100 voltage injection test set. | 2
Connect the Stop leads of the time measuring instrument to points (17, 18) on Test plug type RTXH 18. | 3
Inject voltage onto points (9, 10) on Test plug type RTXH 18. | 4
Raise the voltage gradually until the first stage indication appears. | 5
Record the first stage voltage value. | 6
Switch off the voltage injection test set. | 7
Reset the time measuring instrument. | 8
Connect the voltage injection test set. | 9
Record the first stage time value. | 10
Raise the voltage gradually until the second stage indication appears. | 11
Record the second stage voltage value. | 12
Switch off the voltage injection test set. | 13
Reset the time measuring instrument. | 14
Connect the voltage injection test set. | 15
Record the second stage time value. | 16
Switch off the voltage injection test set. | 17
Withdraw Test plug type RTXH 18 from Test socket type RTXP 18 on the relay (a59G). | 18
Reset the relay (a59G). | 19
